title: Reconstructing Boundary Layer Wind Profiles with Machine Learning: A Comparative Study on IGRA Radiosonde Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.13359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wind profiles in the atmospheric boundary layer (ABL) drive short-range forecasting and wind-energy siting, yet sparse radiosonde coverage forces practitioners to interpolate them from a handful of physical predictors. We benchmark modern tabular learners against analytical parameterizations on 158,097 IGRA soundings. CatBoost, TabM, and FT-Transformer reduce RMSE to 1.3-1.6 m/s, against approximately 3 m/s for power-law and Monin-Obukhov fits; once the predictor set is fixed the three architectures differ by less than 0.05 m/s, so accuracy is driven by predictors rather than architecture. A cohort analysis of within-bin profile dispersion places an empirical floor of approximately 1.77 m/s on any point-wise predictor that uses standard radiosonde features, consistent with prior eddy-viscosity inversions. A one-dimensional Fourier Neural Operator applied as a post-hoc corrector to frozen tabular predictions reduces near-surface RMSE on U

translated_title: 使用机器学习重建大气边界层风廓线：基于IGRA探空数据的比较研究
translated_abstract: 大气边界层（ABL）中的风廓线对短期天气预报和风能选址至关重要，然而稀疏的探空观测覆盖迫使从业者仅从少数物理预测变量出发对其进行估算。本研究在158,097个IGRA探空样本上，将现代表格机器学习方法与分析参数化方法进行了基准比较。CatBoost、TabM和FT-Transformer将RMSE降低至1.3-1.6 m/s，而传统的幂律和Monin-Obukhov拟合的RMSE约为3 m/s；一旦预测变量集固定，三种模型架构之间的差异小于0.05 m/s，说明预测精度主要由预测变量决定而非模型架构。对组内廓线离散度的队列分析表明，对于使用标准探空特征的任何逐点预测器而言，存在约1.77 m/s的经验精度下限，这与先前基于涡粘性反演的研究结果一致。此外，将一维傅里叶神经算子作为事后校正器应用于冻结的表格模型预测，可降低近地面的RMSE。
tldr: 该研究基于158,097个IGRA探空数据比较了CatBoost、TabM和FT-Transformer等现代机器学习方法与传统解析参数化方法在边界层风廓线重建中的表现，发现机器学习将RMSE从约3 m/s大幅降至1.3-1.6 m/s，并揭示了预测精度主要取决于预测变量而非模型架构，同时给出了逐点预测器约1.77 m/s的经验精度下限。
